pinRationale: Pinned to HEAD at the time this matrix was hardened. Gradle 9.7.1 runs natively on a JDK-21 runner, so this repo exercises the 'ordinary' path (no JDK discovery fallback needed) alongside Sunflower/Signal's forced-discovery path.
groundTruthMethod: gradleVersion/androidSdkVersion were confirmed by reading build files. moduleCount is NOT simply the number of include(...) lines (35): settings.gradle.kts uses multi-segment paths like include(":core:analytics") and include(":feature:foryou:api"), and Gradle auto-creates an implicit parent project for every intermediate segment (:core, :feature, :feature:foryou, :feature:interests, :feature:bookmarks, :feature:topic, :feature:search, :feature:settings, :sync) whether or not that segment has its own include(...) line — 9 implicit parents on top of the 35 explicit includes = 44. jdkVersion and androidBuildToolsVersion/androidNdkVersion were confirmed by running `gradlezilla generate --dry-run --format json` against this exact pinned checkout (with a full local Android SDK present, since one module's configuration otherwise fails on SDK license/component auto-install unrelated to gradlezilla itself).

jdkVersion.source: verified run: extractionMetadata.jdkVersionSource="agpMinimum" — build-logic/convention/.../KotlinAndroid.kt sets sourceCompatibility/jvmTarget = JavaVersion.VERSION_11 (a bytecode-compatibility setting, not a Gradle/Kotlin toolchain declaration), so it does not drive jdkVersion; AGP 9.3.2 (gradle/libs.versions.toml androidGradlePlugin=9.3.2) requires JDK 17+, which is what resolves

androidBuildToolsVersion.source: verified run: not set anywhere in build-logic convention plugins or module build files; this is AGP 9.3.2's own default build-tools version (same default observed for Timber's AGP 9.4.0 and Wikipedia's AGP 9.4.1 — the AGP 9.x line defaults build-tools to match its own release train, not the project's compileSdk)

moduleCount.source: 35 explicit include(...) statements in settings.gradle.kts + 9 implicit parent projects created by multi-segment paths (:core, :feature, :feature:foryou, :feature:interests, :feature:bookmarks, :feature:topic, :feature:search, :feature:settings, :sync); build-logic is a separate included build (pluginManagement.includeBuild) and is not one of these. Confirmed by verified run (modules array length = 44)

ndkPresent.source: verified run: androidNdkVersion="28.2.13676358" — AGP 9.x auto-resolves a default NDK version even when android.ndkVersion is unset and the project has no native code (same behavior observed for Timber and Wikipedia, both also on AGP 9.x); AGP 8.x (Sunflower, Signal) does not do this. This means, for any AGP-9.x project, gradlezilla's androidNdkVersion field does NOT indicate whether the project actually uses native code — only whether AGP resolved a default, which it always does
